% Pattern: number/within. \numberwithin after \renewcommand\thetheorem sets the
% format again to \thesection.\arabic{theorem}. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.2
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2.1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\renewcommand{\thetheorem}{\arabic{theorem}}
\numberwithin{theorem}{section}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Every finite space is compact. \end{lemma}
\section{Two}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
